subject: Discussing feasibility of a new proposal - Building Machine Learning Systems with R

messages.author: 57297206b753f4e3
messages.subject: Discussing feasibility of a new proposal - Building Machine Learning Systems with R
parts:
Hi all,

I had this idea of implementing the fundamental machine learning algorithms in R. I wanted to ask if this can be a feasible GSoC'14 project. We can implement the algorithms taught in a standard machine learning course. For example, nearly 100,1000 students enroll for the machine learning course on Coursera taught by Andrew Ng. So, it would be good for students to have a library with functions which can be used to build complex machine learning systems. 


Thanks and Regards,
Shubham
